subject: Acme MAP: Post-demo recap & mutual action plan (next steps)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Shea <liam@acme.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 8 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Acme MAP: Post-demo recap & mutual action plan (next steps)

Hi Liam —

Thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap of what we covered and the proposed mutual action plan (MAP) to keep things moving: 

Pain points / goals you shared
- High per-request latency for interactive search features, causing poor UX across peak traffic windows
- Rising inference costs on existing hosted solution; need to reduce per-1000-token spend by ~30%
- Security requirement: customer PII must be stored only in Acme-managed KMS for auditability

Business goals
- Launch improved search experience to 50k DAU by Nov 1 (Q4 ramp)
- Reduce inference unit costs to meet procurement threshold for Dedicated capacity

Stakeholders we captured
- Liam O'Shea (Product lead) — decision influencer
- Emma Park (Procurement) — contract/terms owner 
- Nisha Rao (Engineering manager) — technical eval/stage gate

Proposed MAP / next milestones
1) Week of 7/12 — Provide detailed MAP + cost estimate (attached) 
2) Week of 7/19 — 1-week Dedicated POC: baseline performance tests with sample dataset (Redwood provides config + test scripts)
3) 8/2 — Security questionnaire & KMS integration plan finalized with Acme security (Emily?)
4) 8/16 — Procurement review & contract redlines submitted
5) 9/1 — Target go/no-go for production rollout (can shift earlier with accelerated POC)

Immediate asks from Acme
- Confirm stakeholders above and add any missing reviewers (procurement contact especially)
- Confirm 7/19 as acceptable start for POC window
- Share a sanitized sample dataset or representative token distribution by 7/15 so we can pre-tune batching/quantization recommendations

Attachments: Acme_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP + milestones), redwood-price-estimate.pdf (ballpark pricing for Dedicated/hosted hybrid)
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567

If that alignment looks right I can update the MAP and lock the POC dates. Happy to hop on a 15-min sync if you'd like to walk through the timeline.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
(415) 555-2198

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. This aligns with our internal thinking. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Procurement: Emma will lead contract/terms (cc'd). Our procurement cycle usually takes ~3 weeks once we receive final pricing and SOW.
- Decision process: Product + Engineering will run the POC and provide a technical sign-off; Procurement will need pricing + SOC2 evidence before legal signs off. 
- Timeline: 7/19 POC start looks good, as long as you can provide the test harness and a pre-configured image by 7/16.
- Stakeholders: Add Rajiv Patel (Platform infra) — I'll intro separately if needed.

We'll aim to share a sanitized dataset by 7/15. One ask from engineering: can you call out expected token distribution and the cost sensitivity thresholds you used for the pricing pdf? Emma — I'll send procurement template and preferred contract language later today.

Liam

Acme Corp
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Shea <liam@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme MAP: Post-demo recap & mutual action plan (next steps)

Liam / Marissa —

Quick technical notes to prepare for the POC: 
- For the POC we recommend Dedicated g4dn-equivalent pool with 2x nodes to match the interactive 95th percentile targets you showed. We can run a quick benchmark and tune batching/kv-cache to hit latency SLOs.
- Token distribution we used for the quote: median request ~120 tokens, 95th percentile ~640 tokens. If your distribution skews much longer we should revisit the estimate.
- We'll include a prebuilt test harness and Docker image by 7/16; please send the sanitized sample dataset to support@redwood.ai.

I'll prepare a short runbook for the POC (what we'll measure, pass/fail criteria) and share it by Monday 7/13.

—Vivek
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
